name: Breathing Glow
description: The classic glowing graph; the presets below tune it. Its glow can breathe when Glow breathing is on.

name: Night Sky
description: Notes as stars and tags as constellations. With motion on, the starlight twinkles slowly.

name: Pulse
description: A still graph. With motion on, saving a note sends light along its links, then it settles.

name: Aurora Lite
description: Soft curtains of colour rise over your biggest tag clusters. With motion on, they breathe slowly.

name: Ink & Paper
description: A printed plate: ink on warm paper, fully still. With motion on, saving a note bleeds ink for two seconds.

name: Aurora
description: Each tag cluster casts a slow curtain of coloured light; additive blending makes hubs glow brighter, not muddier.

name: Bauhaus
description: A poster in primaries: tags become shapes as well as colours, and the biggest hubs anchor large compositional forms.

name: Celestial
description: A star chart: notes become stars with diffraction spikes and orbital rings, slowly rotating around the pole.

name: LED Board
description: The graph resampled onto a grid of physical LEDs, unlit diodes faintly visible, with a ticker of vault stats.

name: Metro
description: A transit diagram: positions snap to a grid, links route at 45° and 90°, each tag's link tree becomes a coloured line.

name: Mycelium
description: Links grow as wandering hyphae and notes as spore clusters; amber pulses travel out from notes you just edited.

name: Phosphor
description: A green phosphor terminal: tags become glyphs, links are dotted, with scanlines, a slow roll bar and a live watch line.

name: Pocket Pixel
description: Drawn at quarter resolution, quantised to a 4-shade handheld palette with ordered Bayer dithering, scaled up with hard pixels.

name: Risograph
description: A riso print: each tag gets a real riso ink on its own slightly misregistered plate, hubs are halftone-screened.

name: Sketchbook
description: Pencil on ruled paper: wobbly hand-drawn links and circled notes.

name: Stained Glass
description: Every note is a pane of coloured glass (a Voronoi cell) set in dark lead, lit from behind.

name: Cross-stitch
description: Embroidered on Aida cloth: notes become blocks of X stitches, links are backstitched in dark thread.

name: Survey
description: A topographic survey sheet: link density becomes contour lines, hubs are summits, the link tree becomes footpaths.

name: Synapse
description: Shows activity: recently edited notes fire every few seconds and the pulse travels outward hop by hop through your links.

name: Territories
description: An atlas page: each note claims a Voronoi cell, tags become countries with dashed borders, hubs become capitals.

name: Ink Wash
description: Watercolour on paper: pigment bleeds around each note and links are soft brush strokes.
